events.factual_description: Jazz at Lincoln Center presents the US debut of the symphonic RITMO tribute to Chick Corea at Rose Theater on March 12–13, 2027, at 7:30 PM. Paquito D’Rivera joins a symphony orchestra under Josep Vicent with Emilio Solla Trio. The arrangements reimagine works including Spain and Armando’s Rhumba, drawing on the RITMO collaboration recorded in Alicante in July 2021. The presenter does not identify individual orchestra or trio members or provide a verified event-specific face-value price.

en.why_it_matters: Paquito D’Rivera brings his pan-American jazz and classical fluency to the US debut of a real symphonic treatment of Chick Corea, shaped by Josep Vicent and Emilio Solla’s Argentine-arranged perspective. Hearing the orchestral writing meet an onstage jazz trio offers a particular Latin lineage and scale—not a generic anniversary set.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for either Rose Theater night if a New York trip fits March. The US-debut context and exact jazz-orchestra conception earn A+; the earlier Alicante recording and two New York performances do not establish S-level irreproducibility.

es.why_it_matters: Paquito D’Rivera lleva su dominio del jazz latino y la música de concierto al debut estadounidense de una lectura sinfónica de Chick Corea, concebida por Josep Vicent y con arreglos de Emilio Solla. La fricción entre orquesta y trío de jazz, más el acento panamericano del repertorio, convierte el homenaje en una propuesta musical concreta.
es.trip_verdict: Le haría espacio a cualquiera de las dos noches en Rose Theater si se arma un viaje a Nueva York en marzo. El debut en Estados Unidos y el planteamiento orquestal justifican A+; la grabación previa en Alicante y las dos funciones no prueban una ocasión irrepetible.

events.factual_description: Roulette presents Fay Victor’s expanded eight-movement Faith, The Gift on Wednesday, March 17, 2027, at 8:00 PM. The multidisciplinary work joins original music, language and movement, with the ten listed performers and a free livestream announced. The work premiered in April 2026, so this is not advertised as its world premiere. General admission is $25 advance or $30 at the door, with separate discounted student/senior admission.

en.why_it_matters: This is a composed, ensemble-scale response to personal loss and violence rather than an interchangeable avant-jazz date: Fay Victor expands Faith, The Gift into eight movements spanning voice, words, movement, winds and rhythm. The credited musicians—Nicole Mitchell, Marty Ehrlich, Angelica Sanchez and others—give the narrative wide improvisational resources.
en.trip_verdict: Make active room for this A+ Brooklyn performance if its subject and multidisciplinary format resonate. The known earlier premiere and a free livestream reduce any claim that travel is essential or that the night is one-off S scarcity.

es.why_it_matters: Fay Victor transforma una pérdida familiar y sus ecos de violencia en ocho movimientos donde se cruzan canto, palabra, danza e improvisación. Con Nicole Mitchell, Marty Ehrlich, Angelica Sanchez y un ensamble de vientos y ritmo, Faith, The Gift tiene una arquitectura narrativa y musical propia, no sólo el atractivo de juntar grandes instrumentistas.
es.trip_verdict: Le haría un hueco importante a esta función en Brooklyn si interesan la improvisación y la narración escénica. Es A+ por el diseño y el elenco; ya hubo un estreno anterior y habrá transmisión gratuita, así que no corresponde presentarla como cita irrepetible.
